A sturdy zinc alloy stand with a double-ring design gives strong support and keeps your phone steady in both landscape and portrait mode, leaving your hands free.
The dual-ring magnetic design makes the phone noticeably easier to hold and use with one hand.
It supports the phone firmly whether you are holding it, taking photos or pressing the Capture Button one-handed. The shape stays comfortable even for smaller hands.
Powerful MagSafe magnets snap into place effortlessly. A magnetic strength of up to 1.2 kg lets you carry the device on one finger without worrying about slips or drops.
At just 5.9 mm thick, the grip slides into a pocket without adding bulk. Placed on a desk it lifts the phone slightly so the camera lenses stay scratch-free.
The aramid fiber is repurposed from camera ring offcuts, which cuts down on wasted material.
